This is the selected native T01 sequence only.

EXT-F-2005-C16_guest.basis: Driver opened empty picker, clicked overlay Cancel, waited for host detach and picker button return, asserted selectedFieldMarkers=0 and panel-target pattern-write requests=[].

EXT-F-2005-C18_guest.basis: Real pointer hover on distinct name and price elements; CDP read closed-shadow highlight display:block and top/left/width/height each within 1px of hovered target; native result records two different target rectangles.

EXT-F-2005-C19_guest.basis: Trusted page click produced picker entry Cedar chair; Done returned field_1 selector in Data; page query found exactly one element and confirmed it was the clicked heading.

EXT-F-2005-C21_guest.basis: After a fresh pick of the $429 element, driver asserted its picker entry, clicked overlay Cancel, waited for host detach, and compared Data selected-field/controls baseline before and after; panel-target pattern writes remained [].

EXT-F-2005-C22_guest.basis: Fresh picker entry Cedar chair was present before Clear; after clicking Clear, closed-shadow #picked HTML had no picked-item.

EXT-F-2005-T07_guest.basis: All guest T07 expected outcomes in inventory.json are observed in this native sequence: hover highlight tracks page elements, click adds an entry and uniquely identifies the clicked heading, Clear empties picker entries, selected-field Cancel exits without returning a field to Data, and the panel-target no-pattern-write observer saw zero non-GET /wbx_pattern requests. No additional guest T07 criterion remains unverified by this run; the observer scope is an evidence-quality limit, not a newly imposed acceptance requirement.

EXT-F-2005-T07_across_modes.basis: The canonical T07 procedure says to repeat the same sequence separately in guest, member and admin profiles. This run covers guest only. Member and admin are independent unverified axes; they do not reduce the guest verdict.

strengths: Raw ZIP hash, native JSON and three resource finals agree with a completed guest run; verdict does not rely on workflow green alone.
Driver uses real pointer actions and reads actual closed-shadow picker DOM, panel DOM and page selectors; hover geometry and C19 selector assertions are stronger than a fixture echo.
limits: The artifact ZIP does not include the original release receipt; provenance fields in native JSON/report were not independently rederived from a release ZIP in this review.
No retained screenshot shows the completed picker or Data controls. The two QA images are setup captures; native DOM/CDP assertions are the interaction evidence, not post-control visual frames.
No scrollY or explicit nonzero scroll was recorded. scrollIntoViewIfNeeded in the pointer helper is insufficient to prove the original scrolled-page scenario.

No signed-in save or persistence readback; neither is an additional guest T07 acceptance criterion. The no-write observer listens to Network.requestWillBeSent on the panel CDP target for non-GET URLs ending /wbx_pattern; it does not monitor all browser targets or the backend. Current savePattern inserts extend.wbx_pattern via src/lib/supabase/queries.ts, so the path filter matches the expected table endpoint when a panel request is emitted.
Candidate is a key-adapted Store ZIP in a native harness; published Store-installed behavior is unverified. No whole Data feature or member/admin verdict follows.
